title: Migrate aggregation to emit structured shopping-list content
description: Update aggregation-related code so recipe aggregation still returns the existing aggregate shape but the shopping-list write path now produces structured document entries instead of line-oriented markdown fragments.
acceptance_criteria: Aggregation-facing shopping-list entry formatting no longer depends on `ShoppingListLineFormatter` producing full markdown checklist lines.
`Aggregation.swift` is updated so shopping-list creation/appending can populate `ShoppingListDocument` directly from aggregated aisle data.
Any helper needed to derive `ShoppingListEntry.text` from aggregated items is located in the new structured flow rather than the deleted text-mutation path.

handoff_summary.completed: 1. Aggregation.swift: Added `public extension AggregatedShoppingList { func apply(to document: inout ShoppingListDocument) }` that iterates aisles and calls `document.addItem(item.entryText, toAisle:)`. Added `extension AggregatedItem { var entryText: String }` with private `formatQuantity`/`formatNumber` helpers — same logic as ShoppingListLineFormatter but placed in the structured flow inside CookbookCore. 2. AddToShoppingListService.swift: Both `append()` and `create()` now parse existing text into ShoppingListDocument(markdown:), call doc.addMealsEntry and aggregated.apply(to:&doc), then write back via doc.renderMarkdown(). Removed the private writeItems(from:to:) helper that called ShoppingListLineFormatter.format(). 3. ShoppingListLineFormatter.swift: not touched — its deletion is deferred to B-692930d9.
handoff_summary.remaining: ShoppingListLineFormatter.swift deletion with call-site migration (B-692930d9). AddToShoppingListServiceTests.swift may need test updates since the write output now comes from ShoppingListDocument.renderMarkdown() instead of ShoppingList.text — the tester agent should verify and update as needed. New coverage needed for AggregatedItem.entryText and AggregatedShoppingList.apply(to:).
handoff_summary.risks: AddToShoppingListServiceTests.swift tests the create() path by checking the written markdown content. The old create() path started with `ShoppingList("# name\n")` (a single line), while the new path uses `ShoppingListDocument(title: name)` which renders via renderMarkdown() with canonical double-newline section separators. Tests asserting exact markdown output may fail and need adjustment by the tester agent.
handoff_summary.next_action: Tester agent should verify AddToShoppingListServiceTests.swift still passes (or update expected output strings to match ShoppingListDocument.renderMarkdown() format) and add new tests for AggregatedItem.entryText and AggregatedShoppingList.apply(to:).
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: AddToShoppingListServiceTests.swift may have hardcoded expected markdown strings that match the old ShoppingList.text output format. B-692930d9 (ShoppingListLineFormatter deletion) depends on this bead; it should proceed safely since ShoppingListLineFormatter is still present and its tests are unaffected.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Placed AggregatedItem.entryText and its private helpers directly in Aggregation.swift (same file as AggregatedItem definition) rather than a separate file, keeping the structured-flow helper co-located with the aggregation types. Made apply(to:) public so CookbookApp can call it; entryText is internal (default Swift access) since it is only called within CookbookCore. The nil-named Other bucket maps to the literal string "Other" in both the old and new paths — no behavior change there.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: ShoppingListLineFormatterTests.swift is unaffected (formatter still compiles and behaves identically). AddToShoppingListServiceTests.swift may need updates for the renderMarkdown() output format difference in create(). New unit tests needed: AggregatedItem.entryText (all quantity-count branches), AggregatedShoppingList.apply(to:) round-trip.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: ShoppingListLineFormatter.swift is still present and its public format(_:) API is still callable; it is now a dead code path for the main write flow but remains until B-692930d9 removes it. SourceKit showed false-positive diagnostics during editing due to stale index; swift build on CookbookCore confirms the code compiles cleanly.

conflict_risks: AddToShoppingListServiceTests.swift may have hardcoded expected markdown strings that match the old ShoppingList.text output format. B-692930d9 (ShoppingListLineFormatter deletion) depends on this bead; it should proceed safely since ShoppingListLineFormatter is still present and its tests are unaffected.

execution_history.summary: Migrated the shopping-list write path from text-oriented ShoppingList mutations to structured ShoppingListDocument operations. Added AggregatedShoppingList.apply(to:) and AggregatedItem.entryText to Aggregation.swift; rewrote AddToShoppingListService to use ShoppingListDocument throughout. CookbookCore package builds cleanly.
